build_ImageSearch: build an ImageSearch instance with YOLOv8 or OwlViT to detect objects and estimate 3D positions from camera images
run_heuristic_object_search_and_navigati: run heuristic object search and navigation to locate a target object using cone-based arm scanning and navigate to it
run_scan_arm: run scan_arm to rotate the robot arm across angles and detect 3D object locations using OwlViT multi-class detection
run_scan_base: run scan_base to rotate the robot base across angles and publish detected object locations via ROS topic
review_get_z_offset_by_corner_detection: review get_z_offset_by_corner_detection to apply Harris corner detection on RGB-depth images and filter corners near a bounding box
